description:
Browse meetings newest-first, optionally filtered by government, type, topic, or date.

    Use this for "what are the most recent meetings" or to page through a
    government's history. For topical questions, prefer `search_meetings_semantic`.

category_tag.description: Optional meeting-type filter — an opaque category_tag from discover_meeting_vocabulary (not a guessable slug; don't invent it).
category_tag.title: Category Tag

government_id.description: account_id to list meetings for (from find_local_governments). Omit to list across all governments.
government_id.title: Government Id

topic.description: Optional topic filter — a topic name from discover_meeting_vocabulary, e.g. 'Affordable Housing'.
topic.title: Topic

name: list_recent_meetings
title: List recent meetings
